integrity: Independent validation and an exhaustive bibliographic priority audit have not been performed. Correctness relies on a self-contained counting argument using a previously published visibility equivalence and finite reproducibility checks.
scientific_limitations: Complete total-visibility set/facet polynomials and topology are proved only for the three-factor Hamming family with two binary coordinates; for one binary coordinate only the lower number and the minimum-facet count are classified. Higher-dimensional products, larger facets in general, and bibliographic priority beyond inspected sources remain open.
title: Maximal total-visibility complexes of three-factor Hamming graphs with binary coordinates
